candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so MinSum is never updated.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so MinSum always becomes zero instead of the provided value.
Replace 'if(intitalized)revert();' with 'if(false)revert();' so SetMinSum succeeds even after initialization, changing MinSum after it was previously blocked.
Replace the assignment MinSum = _val with MinSum = _val + 1, so the stored MinSum is always one greater than the argument.
Delete the assignment MinSum = _val so MinSum is never updated and remains 0.
Delete the intitalized guard so SetMinSum can still update MinSum after initialization, changing observable MinSum in sequences where the original reverts.
Delete the assignment statement `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the LogFile address is never set.
Replace the assignment target so Log is set to the caller's address instead of _log.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so the log address can be changed even after initialization.
Invert the guard condition so calls revert when the contract is NOT yet initialized.
Move the `if(intitalized)revert();` statement after the assignment so Log is updated before the revert check.
